  694   def defaultWeather=(value)
  695     @field.defaultWeather  = value
  696     @field.weather         = value
  697     @field.weatherDuration = -1
  698   end
  699 
  700   # Returns the effective weather (note that weather effects can be negated)
  701   def pbWeather
  702     return :None if allBattlers.any? { |b| b.hasActiveAbility?([:CLOUDNINE, :AIRLOCK]) }
  703     return @field.weather
  704   end
  705 
  706   # Used for causing weather by a move or by an ability.
  707   def pbStartWeather(user, newWeather, fixedDuration = false, showAnim = true)
  708     return if @field.weather == newWeather
  709     @field.weather = newWeather
  710     duration = (fixedDuration) ? 5 : -1
  711     if duration > 0 && user && user.itemActive?
  712       duration = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerWeatherExtender(user.item, @field.weather,
  713                                                             duration, user, self)
  714     end
  715     @field.weatherDuration = duration
  716     weather_data = GameData::BattleWeather.try_get(@field.weather)
  717     pbCommonAnimation(weather_data.animation) if showAnim && weather_data
  718     pbHideAbilitySplash(user) if user
  719     case @field.weather
  720     when :Sun         then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sunlight turned harsh!"))
  721     when :Rain        then pbDisplay(_INTL("It started to rain!"))
  722     when :Sandstorm   then pbDisplay(_INTL("A sandstorm brewed!"))
  723     when :Hail        then pbDisplay(_INTL("It started to hail!"))
  724     when :HarshSun    then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sunlight turned extremely harsh!"))
  725     when :HeavyRain   then pbDisplay(_INTL("A heavy rain began to fall!"))
  726     when :StrongWinds then pbDisplay(_INTL("Mysterious strong winds are protecting Flying-type Pokémon!"))
  727     when :ShadowSky   then pbDisplay(_INTL("A shadow sky appeared!"))
  728     end
  729     # Check for end of primordial weather, and weather-triggered form changes
  730     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange }
  731     pbEndPrimordialWeather
  732   end
  733 
  734   def pbEndPrimordialWeather
  735     return if @field.weather == @field.defaultWeather
  736     oldWeather = @field.weather
  737     # End Primordial Sea, Desolate Land, Delta Stream
  738     case @field.weather
  739     when :HarshSun
  740       if !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DESOLATELAND)
  741         @field.weather = :None
  742         pbDisplay("The harsh sunlight faded!")
  743       end
  744     when :HeavyRain
  745       if !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:PRIMORDIALSEA)
  746         @field.weather = :None
  747         pbDisplay("The heavy rain has lifted!")
  748       end
  749     when :StrongWinds
  750       if !pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DELTASTREAM)
  751         @field.weather = :None
  752         pbDisplay("The mysterious air current has dissipated!")
  753       end
  754     end
  755     if @field.weather != oldWeather
  756       # Check for form changes caused by the weather changing
  757       allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange }
  758       # Start up the default weather
  759       pbStartWeather(nil, @field.defaultWeather) if @field.defaultWeather != :None
  760     end
  761   end

  763   def pbStartWeatherAbility(new_weather, battler, ignore_primal = false)
  764     return if !ignore_primal && [:HarshSun, :HeavyRain, :StrongWinds].include?(@field.weather)
  765     return if @field.weather == new_weather
  766     pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
  767     if !Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  768       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} activated!", battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName))
  769     end
  770     fixed_duration = false
  771     fixed_duration = true if Settings::FIXED_DURATION_WEATHER_FROM_ABILITY &&
  772                              ![:HarshSun, :HeavyRain, :StrongWinds].include?(new_weather)
  773     pbStartWeather(battler, new_weather, fixed_duration)
  774     # NOTE: The ability splash is hidden again in def pbStartWeather.
  775   end

  789     duration = (fixedDuration) ? 5 : -1

  792                                                             duration, user, self)
  793     end
  794     @field.terrainDuration = duration
  795     terrain_data = GameData::BattleTerrain.try_get(@field.terrain)
  796     pbCommonAnimation(terrain_data.animation) if terrain_data
  797     pbHideAbilitySplash(user) if user
  798     case @field.terrain
  799     when :Electric

  801     when :Grassy

  803     when :Misty
  804       pbDisplay(_INTL("Mist swirled about the battlefield!"))
  805     when :Psychic
